candidates.title: Data Center Buildings
candidates.description:
This layer was developed and intended to track data center buildings in Prince William County, Virginia. Using different data sources including Tyler LMS (Energov) and other county software, the layer tracks data center buildings from a inception to occupancy and operational status.

For any questions or feedback, please visit the Planning Office's Build Out Analysis webpage.

candidates.title: Data Center Projects
candidates.description:
These polygon areas contain projects that have rezoning approval by the Board of County Supervisors. The projects can be in any phase of development. Some projects may be in the middle of the construction process, some may contain a section or landbay that is undeveloped, while others may be a project in which no development has started. Non-Residentially zoned projects with final development yet to occur.

For any questions or feedback, please visit the Planning Office's Build Out Analysis webpage.

candidates.title: Data Center Opportunity Zone Overlay District
candidates.description:
The Data Center Opportunity Zone Overlay District was created for the purpose of promoting development of data centers within areas of the County where there is existing infrastructure that could adequately support the proposed use. This District continues the County's efforts to attract and advance high-tech industrial development while limiting negative impacts to communities.

(Ord. No. 16-21, Attch., 5-17-16)

candidates.title: Healthcare Workforce Data Center DASHBOARDS - Datathon23
candidates.description:
The Department of Health Professions Healthcare Workforce Data Center works to improve the data collection and measurement of Virginia’s healthcare workforce through regular assessment of workforce supply and demand issues among the over 62 professions and the over 500,000 practitioners licensed in Virginia by DHP.
DHP healthcare workforce data is provided online to ensure accessibility of the findings among healthcare decision makers, hospital systems, academic institutions and constituents statewide.

candidates.description:
